source: live Analytics Engine answer for nemar_website_embeds, which no point has been written to yet (the production situation before the website's counting ships), read through the same temporary diagnostic route
query: SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day, blob3 AS kind, SUM(_sample_interval) AS loads FROM nemar_website_embeds WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-10-05 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-06 00:00:00') GROUP BY day, kind ORDER BY day
